title: Secret of the Bloodline
next_chapter_hook: In the depth of night, the Jade Pendant beside Su Qingyao's pillow suddenly emitted a cold, faint glow, as if responding to some kind of summons spanning across a thousand years—and Chen Ji observed all of this.

text.content:
The alliance was formed, and as Chen Ji was about to leave, Ye Qing suddenly spoke—"One more thing." A strange glint flickered in those deep eyes of hers, "Chen Xuan once caused my Holy Sect to lose three elders—this debt... did you think one alliance could clear it?"

Chen Ji paused mid-step, yet the warm smile on his face didn't diminish in the slightest: "If the Saint Lady has dissatisfaction, please speak freely. Although Chen is unworthy, I would still like to hear what you have to say."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing let out a light laugh, her slender fingers casually brushing aside a strand of hair by her temple: "The lives of three elders must naturally be repaid by Chen Xuan's bloodline. However—" She shifted her tone, her gaze sweeping over Su Qingyao behind Chen Ji with an amused expression, "Your little girlfriend is quite pretty."

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart stirred slightly, yet his expression remained unchanged: "The Saint Lady过誉了. Su Qingyao is merely an Inner Disciple of the Tianqing Sect—how could she deserve such praise."

Ye Qing seemed not to hear his words, murmuring to herself: "Su... Qingyao... This surname is rather interesting." A subtle fluctuation flickered in those deep eyes of hers—a fluctuation even she herself had not noticed.

dialogue.content: "Does the Saint Lady seem particularly interested in Su Qingyao?" Chen Ji nonchalantly shifted his body, precisely blocking Ye Qing from Su Qingyao, his voice still mild: "I wonder what significance this surname holds in your Holy Sect?"

Ye Qing came back to her senses, the异样 in her eyes already concealed, replaced by her usual languid smile: "Nothing, merely reminiscing about some old matters. The girl beside you has a background more complicated than she herself knows."

She glanced meaningfully at Chen Ji: "Some secrets, the deeper they're buried, the more shocking they become when unearthed."

text.content:
Chen Ji's smile remained unchanged, yet his heart was already churning like a tempest.

The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea burned with heat—he clearly sensed this was a warning. This meant Ye Qing's words were by no means idle chatter. Su Qingyao's background held variables even he had never foreseen.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao stood by Chen Ji's side, silent throughout. Though she couldn't hear what Ye Qing whispered, she keenly sensed that moment when Ye Qing's gaze had fallen upon her—the异样 in those eyes.

"Brother Chen." She lowered her voice, "Those of the Demonic Path are inherently treacherous. Are you truly going to ally with such a person?"

text.content:
Chen Ji turned back, his voice warm: "Rest assured, Junior Sister Su, I have my own judgment."

His gaze inadvertently swept over the Jade Pendant at Su Qingyao's waist—that贴身之物 she never parted from, its body lustrous, faintly glowing. But just now, when Ye Qing mentioned her surname, that pendant had trembled almost imperceptibly.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing seemed to sense Chen Ji's gaze, a playful arc curling at the corner of her mouth: "Chen Gongzi is quite protective." She turned and swept her sleeve, her voice散入 in the night wind, "Very well, some matters will inevitably be revealed. I'll only remind you of one thing—"

"The Su family's daughters, there was more than one."

text.content:
When her words faded, Ye Qing's silhouette had already vanished into the night.

Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his expression calm as ever, only the fingertips that subtly tightened within his sleeves betraying his inner turmoil. The Su family, more than one daughter—this meant Su Qingyao had siblings? But she had clearly stated she was the only child in her family.

Unless... she had been separated from her true family since childhood.

A gust of night wind brushed past, and Su Qingyao's Jade Pendant trembled lightly once more. This time, she herself noticed the anomaly, lowering her gaze to see—on the pendant's smooth surface, an extremely faint pattern had emerged—shaped like an inverted short sword, bearing seven or eight resemblance to the emblem of a certain faction within the Demonic Holy Sect.

dialogue.content: "Oh?" Su Qingyao frowned, cradling the Jade Pendant in her palm for closer examination, "This pattern... I've worn it for over a decade and never seen it." She murmured to herself, her fingertips gently stroking that suddenly appearing pattern, "Strange, how could this pendant..."

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze微凝, yet he forcibly suppressed the turbulence in his heart, a mild smile appearing on his face: "Perhaps Junior Sister's cultivation advanced, and the pendant, nourished by Spiritual Energy, has undergone some change?" His tone was carefree, as if merely soothing his Junior Sister's doubts, "No need to worry overly. After returning to the mountain, have a master examine it."

In truth, his heart was as clear as a mirror—this Jade Pendant was clearly a vessel for some kind of bloodline imprint. The connection between Su Qingyao and the Demonic Path was likely far deeper than it appeared.

Chen Ji's gaze sank slightly, his hand gently pressing Su Qingyao's shoulder, his voice low and firm: "Junior Sister, no matter what happens, I will protect you."

Su Qingyao froze for a moment—for some reason, from those eyes that had always beenwarm, she saw a solemnity she had never witnessed before.

text.content:
Chen Ji watched Su Qingyao leave, standing alone in the courtyard. The night wind brushed past his robes, bringing autumn's chill.

The Tianji Record Fragment hummed faintly in his mental sea—an unusual resonance suggesting something long dormant was awakening. And the inverted dagger pattern on Su Qingyao's jade pendant clearly belonged to the 'Blood Blade' lineage of the Demonic Holy Sect.

He recalled Mo Xiansheng's words: 'What the Tianji Record illuminates are threads of karma. Those with deep connections become inextricably intertwined; those with shallow connections pass by like strangers.'

Was Su Qingyao's connection to the Demonic Path merely a jade pendant, or was she herself an unseen piece on this chessboard? Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing his doubts.

Regardless, until the truth emerged, he would not let anyone harm her in the slightest.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—his same mark? Could it be...

text.content:
Chen Ji concealed his presence and quietly followed Su Qingyao. Moonlight bathed her slender silhouette. She seemed troubled, her steps heavier than usual.

Suddenly, Chen Ji's eyes narrowed sharply—Su Qingyao's jade pendant was glowing with an eerie cold light in the moonlight, as if something within was awakening.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, setting aside the Tianji Record's call. Whatever the case, Su Qingyao was the priority.

He silently trailed her through winding corridors to the Bamboo Grove path in the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. Moonlight filtered through bamboo leaves, casting dappled shadows. Su Qingyao's pace gradually slowed, seemingly affected by the night's atmosphere.

Just then, the Jade Pendant at Su Qingyao's waist suddenly burst forth with a dazzling, ghostly glow!

The light was cold and eerie, bearing an unmistakable resemblance to the aura of the Demonic Path. Caught off guard, Su Qingyao looked down—the intricate patterns on the Jade Pendant's surface were slowly writhing, as if something was awakening from deep slumber, about to break free from its shell.

"This is..." Her voice trembled slightly. "Chen Ji-shixiong?!"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji stopped hiding and stepped out from the shadows, his voice steady: "I'm here, shimei."

He moved forward swiftly, one hand supporting Su Qingyao's trembling shoulder while the other quietly channeled a wisp of Spiritual Energy into her body. Where he touched, there was only ice-cold stillness—a chill characteristic of when the Demonic Path Bloodline awakens.

text.content:
The ghostly light within the Jade Pendant intensified further. The inverted short sword pattern slowly materialized into实体, and a illusory image was projected from the Jade Pendant—it was an ancient sacrificial altar, and at its center knelt a woman bound in chains, whose face bore a striking seven-tenths resemblance to Su Qingyao.

Su Qingyao was struck like by thunder, her pupils dilating: "That's... is that... Mother?"

Chen Ji's heart jolted violently—could the "Blood Blade Lineage's Sacrifice" that Mo Xiansheng mentioned be Su Qingyao's biological mother?!

The phantom flickered for a moment before finally dissipating. The Jade Pendant returned to silence, yet that cold touch served as a reminder to Chen Ji—that everything just now was no mere hallucination.

Su Qingyao's face was pale as paper. She clutched that Jade Pendant tightly, her knuckles white from the force. "Shixiong... I... what's going on?"

Chen Ji gazed at her bewildered and panicked expression, his heart churning with mixed emotions. At this moment, he realized with stark clarity—Su Qingyao's identity mystery was far more complex, and far more dangerous, than he had ever imagined.
